title: Applications of the finite specializations of the $q$-deformed modular group
summary: Recently, Morier-Genoud and Ovsienko introduced the $q$-deformed modular group. For the construction, they first gave a group $G_q \subset \operatorname{GL}(2, \mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm}])$ and then set $\operatorname{PSL}_q(2,\mathbb{Z}):=G_q/Z(G_q)$. We show that, for $ζ\in \mathbb{C}^*$, $\operatorname{PSL}_q(2,\mathbb{Z})|_{q=ζ}$ is finite, if and only if so is $G_q(ζ):=G_q|_{q=ζ} \subset \operatorname{GL}(2,\mathbb{C})$, if and only if $ζ=ζ_n$ for $n=2,3,4,5$, where $ζ_n$ is a primitive $n$-th root of unity.
